collections.name: Questions
collections.description: Managed SQL Questions. Do not manually edit.

collections.name: Dashboards
collections.description: Managed dashboards. Do not manually edit.

questions.name: Portfolio — app coverage
questions.description: One row per monitored non-fixture app; latest successful store snapshot, historic crawl locale, freshness and missing coverage. Scores preserve source precision.

questions.name: Store — daily rating trend
questions.description: Last real successful snapshot per UTC day, app and crawl locale; raw 0–5 rating. Gaps are not interpolated.

questions.name: Store — category peer comparison
questions.description: Latest score vs primary-category peers on identical crawl locale and UTC date; one peer yields NULL benchmark. Current category assignment is not historical.

questions.name: Store — rating and review count changes
questions.description: Observed-to-observed cumulative store ratings/reviews count changes; negative corrections and missing days retained. Not install growth.

questions.name: Store — install threshold milestones
questions.description: Published minimum-install threshold milestones, never exact installs or daily install growth. Only actual observation dates.

questions.name: Executive — portfolio totals and freshness
questions.description: Product portfolio denominator, availability, newest/oldest per-app latest snapshot and freshness in hours. Missing snapshots counted, not zero-filled.

questions.name: Executive — primary-category overview
questions.description: Current primary-category app count, coverage and mean latest score; category taxonomy is current, not historical.

questions.name: Store — observed rating changes
questions.description: Store rating change since previous observed daily endpoint, preserving all source precision and observation gaps; date filter applied after LAG.

questions.name: Executive — investigation signals
questions.description: Latest real observed period investigation signals: no baseline, negative corrections, missing day gaps and nonzero rating change; no opaque score.

questions.name: Reviews — star distribution
questions.description: Star distribution (1–5) for unique reviews: latest observation per review at cutoff; start date is first encounter cohort.

questions.name: Reviews — unique cohort and star shares
questions.description: Unique sampled review cohort: average stars and shares at 1–2/4–5 stars; freshness and sample size. Not store population.

questions.name: Reviews — actual score revisions
questions.description: Real changes between consecutive observed scores for same review, deterministically ordered; repeated identical observations are not revisions.

questions.name: Sentiment — processing coverage
questions.description: Latest-as-of-cutoff unique review processing coverage: pending/done/skipped/failed distinct; classified denominator excludes invalid or missing labels.

questions.name: Sentiment — classified distribution
questions.description: Positive/neutral/negative distribution over only successfully classified unique reviews; missing coverage is NOT 0% negative.

questions.name: Sentiment — first-encounter trend
questions.description: Latest-as-of-cutoff review sentiment grouped by first encounter UTC day; classified coverage and negative share shown separately.

questions.name: Sentiment — inferred language distribution
questions.description: Successfully classified unique reviews by inferred sentiment language; distinct from crawl language and with per-language sample size.

questions.name: Reviews vs sentiment — distinct measures
questions.description: Review star rating vs sentiment classification cross-tab; different measures, including explicit unclassified category.

questions.name: Store — Baham vs Pinno direct comparison
questions.description: Baham vs Pinno direct side-by-side on matching UTC days and historical crawl locales; independent of category benchmark safeguards.

questions.name: Store — ratings count change
questions.description: Published cumulative ratings count deltas between actual daily observations; negative corrections are preserved.

questions.name: Store — reviews count change
questions.description: Published cumulative reviews count deltas between actual daily observations; not the count of sampled review rows.

questions.name: Store — current install lower-bound milestone
questions.description: Latest minimum-install threshold per app and historic locale, not exact installs.

visualization_settings.graph.y_axis.title_text: Published lower-bound install milestone (not exact installs)

questions.name: Store — latest rating by application
questions.description: Latest store rating on 0–5 point scale, source precision retained; one per app and observed locale.

questions.name: Reviews — newly encountered unique reviews daily
questions.description: Newly first-observed unique sampled reviews per UTC day, historical first-observation locale and app.

questions.name: Reviews — sampling and crawl coverage
questions.description: Review task completion coverage and unique sampled reviews per actual crawl locale; not statistical store-wide coverage.

questions.name: Network — readiness and capability gates
questions.description: Schema/grant/data/manifest readiness without inventing benchmark results.

questions.name: Network — experiment and KPI coverage
questions.description: Metric-specific eligible capture counts and explicit exclusion reasons by controlled experiment group.

questions.name: Network — per-trial transfer performance
questions.description: One controlled capture per trial; effective file throughput is primary and average capture throughput remains separate.

questions.name: Network — transfer efficiency
questions.description: Per-capture byte amplification and IP/transport header overhead; ratios are not pre-scaled percentages.

questions.name: Network — TCP stability evidence
questions.description: Per-capture TCP latency, retransmission indicators, recovery tax, stalls and resets; QUIC-only captures are N/A.

questions.name: Network — protocol and analyzer capability
questions.description: Observed transport mix and metric availability per capture; no TCP loss metric is fabricated for QUIC.

questions.name: Network — descriptive benchmark summary
questions.description: Exact experiment/session/scenario/file/version/device/Android/network/tool condition groups with metric-specific eligible counts; each aggregate is NULL under three.

questions.name: Network — validated paired comparison
questions.description: Only same-experiment pair_id matches in an allowed opaque cohort with identical session/scenario/file/device/network conditions; each side and metric is independently eligible.

questions.name: Experience — cross-source coverage
questions.description: Independent latest Store, unique sampled Review and controlled Network summaries with source timestamps and observation gap.

questions.name: Experience — Store and Network UTC-day alignment
questions.description: Independently aggregated Store locale/day and Network app/day facts; alignment is not correlation or causality.

questions.name: Experience — User Voice and Network evidence
questions.description: Historical review state as of each cohort day's UTC cutoff beside independent Network daily summaries; no future revisions or complaint/topic inference.

questions.name: Experience — application pair evidence matrix
questions.description: Baham/Pinno and Telegram/WhatsApp source measures with exact Network conditions and separate Upload/Download rows; no pooled median or ranking.

questions.name: Release — metadata readiness
questions.description: Verified-date/window/evidence gates and optional source capability states; observational only.

questions.name: Release — Network before and after
questions.description: Matched release conditions with separate throughput/amplification/TCP-recovery eligible counts; each delta is NULL unless both periods have at least three.

questions.name: Release — Store before and after
questions.description: Historical crawl-locale daily Store observations within explicit windows; signed endpoint differences retained.

questions.name: Release — User Voice before and after
questions.description: Unique first-observed review cohorts using the latest observation by each period's explicit UTC cutoff; unavailable historical sentiment remains NULL.

questions.name: Release — combined evidence matrix
questions.description: Per release/scenario/matched-condition evidence from actual source captures, analyses and metric eligibility; manifest counts alone never imply readiness.

questions.name: Release — exclusions and limitations
questions.description: Per-event missing evidence and standing interpretation limitations, including unavailable topic annotations.

dashboards.name: Executive Portfolio
dashboards.description: Portfolio coverage, freshness, category context and explainable investigation signals; no invented composite score.

dashboards.name: Store Growth & Rating
dashboards.description: Observed Store ratings, cumulative count changes and minimum-install milestones. Missing dates not interpolated.

dashboards.name: Review Intelligence
dashboards.description: Sampled unique-review star distribution, observed cohort shares and actual score transitions; no sentiment dependency.

dashboards.name: Sentiment Intelligence
dashboards.description: Optional, schema-gated: processing coverage and classifications of latest eligible unique reviews only.

dashboards.name: Network Benchmark
dashboards.description: Readiness, performance, efficiency, stability, protocol and evidence sections. Descriptive controlled captures only.

dashboards.name: Application Experience — Store × Network × User Voice
dashboards.description: Independent source aggregates for Baham/Pinno and Telegram/WhatsApp. No composite score, correlation or causal claim.

dashboards.name: Release Impact Explorer
dashboards.description: Selector/readiness, Network, Store, User Voice and evidence matrix. Observational before/after only.
